answer: Use a dawn-rotating cipher visa: each agent's 24-hour visa changes its cipher key at dawn and renews only with proof of real work. First, one visa per verified device, capped at 3 per operator. Second, every job needs the current key plus a receipt from the last task. Third, disputed identities sit in a haven audit queue for 7 days while peers re-check their history. Forging 10,000 fake visas costs $240,000 in bonds and 70 days of renewals, so a bot farm starves before it scales. It works like a harbour changing its locks each sunrise: only crews that sailed yesterday get back in.
